# `reduce`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Applies a binary operator to an initial state and all
elements in the array, and reduces this to a single state. The final state is converted
into the final result by applying a finish function.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
reduce(expr, start, merge, finish)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [3, 4] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- reduce, example 1
> SELECT reduce(array(1, 2, 3), 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x);
6
```

```sql
-- reduce, example 2
> SELECT reduce(array(1, 2, 3), 0, (acc, x) -> acc + x, acc -> acc * 10);
60
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
